description: Returns one currency/indicator's persisted official-producer history using catalogue identifiers. Rows contain `date` (reference period), numeric `val` and separate publication evidence; no chart metadata. `as_of` selects historically eligible values; current values may include revisions. Newest-first pagination: default 100 rows with `start_date`, otherwise 20; `limit` maximum 100. When `pagination.has_more`, `partial_page.next_call` contains next-page arguments; `partial_page.pages_remaining` counts remaining pages. Official-only by default; prohibited private aggregator rows are always removed. USD is free; non-USD requires an API key. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

as_of.description: Historical decision cutoff with explicit timezone, or YYYY-MM-DD at UTC midnight; verifies vintages before returning rows.

availability.description: Replay clock: public or captured. Used with as_of.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Optional if `slug` is provided as a `"usd:cpi"`-style compound. Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

dataset_version.description: Optional content version; use the first page's version on subsequent pages to reject changed data.

factor.description: Instead of an indicator, return a precomputed macro factor score for `currency`, for example monetary_stance.

include_components.description: factor only: include the stored component scores.

include_sources.description: factor only: include source endpoint references.

indicator.description: Indicator slug for the given currency. Optional if `slug` is provided as a `"usd:cpi"`-style compound. Supported: catalogue indicator slug, e.g. inflation or policy_rate.

limit.description: Rows per page, newest first, maximum 100. Unset means 100 when `start_date` is set, otherwise 20.

official_only.description: When true, return only official-source rows and remove explicit fallback observations. Prohibited private aggregator rows are always removed.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset after most-recent-first ordering. Take it from `partial_page.next_call`.

page.description: One-based page number. When supplied, the REST endpoint derives offset as `(page - 1) * limit`.

revisions.description: Revision view: latest, first, final or all. Historical replay uses latest among vintages eligible at as_of.

series_mode.description: Series mode: canonical or raw. Historical replay defaults to raw.

slug.description: Optional compound `"<currency>:<indicator>"` slug (e.g. `"usd:cpi"`, `"jpy:policy_rate"`). Many small / open tool-calling models concatenate the two parts anyway. When supplied, overrides `currency` and `indicator`.

value_mode.description: Value mode: normalized or source. Historical replay defaults to unchanged source values and requires raw series mode.

name: indicator_query
title: Indicator Time Series
